profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LinkedIn | Former Developer Intern at Barclays | SJSU
profile.summary:
Completed Masters in Software Engineering at San Jose State University with a focus to complete specialization in Enterprise Software Technologies and Data Science. 
Superior technical knowledge from a Computer Engineering degree (Bachelor of Engineering) leveraged with a graduate program in Software Engineering has developed a well-rounded skill set which I wish to exhibit via an opportunity in the technical domain. 

Academic projects ranging from Object Detection and Tracking, developed in OpenCV to most recent Movie Ticketing portal, DevOpsBot, and MovieFlix give a fair overview of my adaptability to dynamic requirements and learnability, my biggest assets. Web development is assisting me to understand about my long-hauled fascination of how web technology is forming the backbone of multi-million dollar companies. 

Technical Skills:
• Languages: Java, C, C++, JavaScript, Python
• Web Technologies: Node JS, React JS, AngularJS, JQuery, Redux, AJAX, HTML, CSS
• Frameworks: Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Express, JUnit, Mocha, REST API
• Technologies and Tools: Visual Studio, Android Studio, Hadoop, OpenCV, IntelliJ, Eclipse, JSP, Tomcat, Git, JMeter, Apache Kafka, JavaFX, Firebase
• Cloud and Databases: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis

RELATED COURSEWORK
Data Structures and Algorithm, Design Patterns, Agile methodologies, Enterprise Distributed Systems, Enterprise Application Development, Enterprise Software Platforms, Large Scale
Analytics, Enterprise Application Development, Software Engineering Processes, Database Management Systems, Data Mining and Analysis

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
CSI-Driver for Local Storage Provisioning
• Designed and developed a Kubernetes CSI driver to provision and manage local persistent storage across all LinkedIn data centers
to enable fast, reliable, and scalable storage provisioning.
• Reduced volume provisioning latency by ~95% and eliminated cross-namespace and cross-host provisioning dependencies.
• Added per-pod storage quota enforcement and partial disk failure handling, improving reliability and preventing pod failures from
isolated disk errors.

Stateful Scheduler
• Developed a Kubernetes scheduling service that resolves pre-deployment infrastructure dependencies, ensuring a seamless on-
boarding process for 300+ products.
• System optimizes the persistent volume allocations for stateful applications within LinkedIn’s infrastructure.

Shared Configs
• Developed a shared configs architecture that manages reusable configs across different applications and environments within
LinkedIn’s infrastructure.
• The newer hierarchical config management system intends to replace the need to use global configs, reducing the error scope by a
significant margin and optimizing the storage and accessibility.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
LSEP (Learning Solutions Enterprise Program) and Free Trials
• Designed and implemented a system which provides a way to sell learning solutions in an easy, cost effective, and flexible way in an
“unlimited” model for multiyear deals.
• Designed and developed a system to offer free trials of Learning Products to customers for a short duration of time before selling long
term contracts.

positions.title: Developer Summer Analyst
positions.description:
Designed and Developed a desktop application for Barclays’ Intercommunication, data sharing, and updates using JavaFx, Java, CSS, MongoDB, Spring Boot which increased the work efficiency, query resolution and data sharing by 80%
Developed a web application for rule management and trade settlements using AngularJS, Node, MongoDB, Java, and Drools Engine
Developed an API for the rules transformation between JSON values or Excel sheet and Drools engine’s file handling format .DRL which helped to increase the rules transformation speed by 78%

positions.title: Web Developer, Content and Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Worked for the web and content development of LearnX, a startup where major part based on designing the app UI and finding functionalities which will make users' task easy. 
Worked on marketing area to make people aware of the online learning.

volunteerExperiences.role: Website Developer and Database Team member
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Major work was based on development and maintenance of the Website for the University's state level event, STAC- 2014, organized by IEEE Student Branch.
•	Maintaining website during the Registration and Event Scheduling tasks with the implementation of the messaging system for users and maintain their data into the database.

projects.title: Movieflix – Video Streaming platform
projects.description:
Worked for analysis, designing, development, deployment, and testing of the project
React JS | Java | Springboot | Hibernate | MySQL | JMeter

• Designed a distributed web application which provides functionalities and features of Netflix using Springboot.
• Developed recommended system based on user clicks by tracking the number of plays and sequence of plays and also an administrator dashboard with web analytics that tracks and displays data.

projects.title: DevOpsBot (Automation for AWS operations)
projects.description:
Developed Alexa custom skills, lambda functions to initiate the request for EC2 request handler
(Alexa Skill Kit | AWS Lambda | AWS EC2 Instances | Java SDK | Amazon CloudWatch | Spring Boot)

•	AWS operations like deploying the application, load scripts, scaling up/down clusters, and querying performance metrics can be performed with voice commands.
•	Conversational approach to the operations instead of performing on AWS console.
•	Integration of Alexa custom skills, AWS lambda intents interpreter and EC2 provision request handler using AWS SDK.
